build_system: None (individual projects have their own requirements)
test_command: python -m pytest (for Year 3 projects with tests)
verification_instructions: Verify Python scripts have valid syntax with `python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(f).read())'`. Verify HTML is well-formed. Check each project has README.
setup_instructions: No global setup needed. Each project is self-contained.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Python 3.11, Node.js 22, npm available.
contribution_requirements: Each project in its own folder. Code quality evolves across years. READMEs evolve from simple to professional.
key_patterns: Year 1: messy beginner code, no OOP, inconsistent naming, simple comments. Year 2: functions, organization, basic error handling. Year 3: OOP, modular, type hints, docstrings, tests.
directory_structure: Root contains 22 project directories plus root-level .gitignore and README
